say:1:1821326001:1.text: There are some gifts left... Where are Silas and Jade?
say:1:1821326001:1.source_cn: 多了几件礼物……塞勒斯和婕德是毕业了吗？

say:2:1821326002:1.text: Silas was adopted, and Jade graduated last week.
say:2:1821326002:1.source_cn: 塞勒斯被一户人家领养了，婕德是上周毕业的，她已经可以独...

say:3:1821326003:1.text: Don't worry, though. I'll make sure your gifts find their way to their new addresses.
say:3:1821326003:1.source_cn: 我会把你为他们准备的礼物寄送到新地址，放心吧，塞涅小姐...

say:4:1821326004:1.text: Thank you. I'm happy to know they've entered a new chapter in their lives.
say:4:1821326004:1.source_cn: 多谢。他们得以开启新的生活篇章，这份礼物也算是份祝福。

say:5:1821326005:1.text: I'm the one who should be grateful, if anything. You've been an absolute gem, staying by the children's side through their hardest days.
say:5:1821326005:1.source_cn: 你愿意陪孩子们度过最艰难的日子，是我应该感谢你，塞涅小姐。

choice_prompt:6:1821326005.text: I'm the one who should be grateful, if anything. You've been an absolute gem, staying by the children's side through their hardest days.
choice_prompt:6:1821326005.source_cn: 你愿意陪孩子们度过最艰难的日子，是我应该感谢你，塞涅小姐。

say:7:1821326006:1.text: Yes, because I work here. If you're curious, I did live here as a resident for a while when I first died.
say:7:1821326006:1.source_cn: 对，但我是孤儿院的员工。不过，我刚死的时候，确实在孤儿...
say:7:1821326006:1.male: Yes, because I work here. If you're curious, I did live here as a resident for a while when I first died.
say:7:1821326006:1.female: Yes, because I work here. If you're curious, I did live here as a resident for a while when I first died.

say:8:1821326008:1.text: I died young, which is why I still look like a child. My appearance makes it easier for me to connect with children who've just arrived.
say:8:1821326008:1.source_cn: 我是早逝者，只是外貌还维持着小孩子的模样。这样和刚刚来...

say:9:1821326009:1.text: This orphanage was built by Lady Tephesia when Novaris was founded. It's for children who have no one to care for them.
say:9:1821326009:1.source_cn: 领主阁下在诺珐斯建立之初就设立了这座孤儿院，专门收留孤...

say:10:1821326010:0.text: We educate the children and help them adapt to life in Novaris. Once they're mature enough to live independently, they "graduate".
say:10:1821326010:0.source_cn: 我们会对孩子们进行再教育，提供必要的生活指引，直到他们...

say:11:1821326011:0.text: While they're here, the orphanage covers all their living expenses. Many families come here hoping to adopt a child too. Naturally, they have to pass a thorough background check first.
say:11:1821326011:0.source_cn: 在这期间，孤儿院会承担一切生活成本。许多重组家庭也会来...

say:12:1821326012:0.text: Lilli's the one who helped me find my footing when I first got to Novaris. So when I found out she worked here, I decided to put on a charity performance for the children.
say:12:1821326012:0.source_cn: 我刚到诺珐斯时，莉栗小姐为我提供了许多当地生活指引。得...

say:13:1821326013:0.text: Because I can still perform onstage and connect with my audience, adjusting to life as a Graveborn hasn't been hard for me.
say:13:1821326013:0.source_cn: 我死后并未对身份转变感到不适，因为我还能继续登台演出，...

say:14:1821326014:0.text: But not everyone is as fortunate as I am, and the transition is especially hard on children. They're forced to face death before they even have the chance to understand the world.
say:14:1821326014:0.source_cn: 但我理解，不是每个人都像我这样幸运——尤其是年幼的孩子...

say:15:1821326015:0.text: I want to be there for them at times like this. They need to face death and understand what it truly means to make the most of their lives here.
say:15:1821326015:0.source_cn: 我想，我有义务在这种时刻陪伴在他们的身边。唯有正视并理...

say:16:1821326016:1.text: Senea's taken to life in Novaris like a duck to water. That makes her a great role model for the children. Besides, they all love spending time with her!
say:16:1821326016:1.source_cn: 塞涅小姐确实比常人要豁达许多，这对孩子们来说也是好事。...

say:18:1821326017:1.text: Lilli, has everyone on your side received their gifts? I've got one extra.
say:18:1821326017:1.source_cn: 莉栗，你那边的孩子都拿到礼物了吗？我这多了一份。

say:19:1821326018:1.text: Huh? That can't be right... There should only be two gifts left, for Silas and Jade. One of the children must not have received theirs.
say:19:1821326018:1.source_cn: 啊？不应该呀……我只挑出了塞勒斯和婕德的两份，是不是有...

say:21:1821326019:1.text: Could it be that boy over in the corner? I didn't see him the last time I was here.
say:21:1821326019:1.source_cn: 也许是角落的那个孩子？我上次来时没有见到他。

say:22:1821326020:1.text: Ah, you might be right. <style="highlight">Brunno</style> only died ten days ago, and I haven't even heard him speak yet.

choice_prompt:23:1821326020.text: Ah, you might be right. <style="highlight">Brunno</style> only died ten days ago, and I haven't even heard him speak yet.
choice_prompt:23:1821326020.source_cn: 哦，确实有可能。<style=highlight>布鲁诺</style>刚刚去世不过十天，我还没听他开口讲过话。

say:24:1821326021:1.text: He's been like that since he got here, but I'm sure he can understand what we say. He just needs a little more time.
say:24:1821326021:1.source_cn: 他来的时候就这样了。不过他能听懂我们在说什么，只要多点...

say:24:1821326021:1.female: He's been like that since he got here, but I'm sure he can understand what we say. He just needs a little more time.

say:27:1821326007:1.text: Maybe that's because I've been dead for four or five hundred years now. I'm one of the staff now.
say:27:1821326007:1.source_cn: 是啊，我已经死了大概四五百年了吧，现在是孤儿院的员工。
say:27:1821326007:1.male: Maybe that's because I've been dead for four or five hundred years now. I'm one of the staff now.
